description: Points d'eau potable - Seine-Saint-Denis - données OSM is a dataset listed in Open Data Seine-Saint-Denis, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Huwise. Ce jeu de données géolocalise les fontaines et points d'eau potable en France. Il se base sur les données OpenStreetMap, qui sont ensuite compilées et traitées par Opendatasoft. Il est mis à jour de manière hebdomadaire afin de récupérer les éléments OpenStreetMap les plus récents. Coverage: Seine-Saint-Denis. The portal files it under Territory. Its keywords are openstreetmap, osm, fontaine, eau potable, france. The portal shows 271 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-seinesaintdenis-fr-portal.
